data.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
data.description: Compromised signing systems likely enabled Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, while Ethereum’s EIP-7702 upgrade may have helped attackers bypass security checks, according to blockchain security firm Blockaid.Attackers could have stolen the funds without EIP-7702, Ido Ben-Natan, Blockaid’s co-founder and…
